description: Hand-crafted example: several live-quality readings from USGS NWIS stations plus an estimated virtual placement reading, all conforming to the #450 ecological sensor schema (schema_version 1.0.0).

readings.notes: Mississippi River at Baton Rouge, LA (07374000); USGS parameter code 00300.
Mississippi River at Baton Rouge, LA (07374000); USGS parameter code 00400.
No live reading retrievable for a schema-supported parameter; value is the survey-area baseline carried over for schema completeness (quality_flag=estimated).

Proposed new monitoring station (virtual sensor). Largest sensor gap lies along bearing 42 deg from the input river point. Proposed station at 75% of the 25 km search radius along that bearing; EPQS elevation 18.6 m. Higher ground is treated as an upstream proxy (documented heuristic); true NHDPlus flowline tracing is out of scope for v0.1.
